# The generalised assays on the 6502 machine: plumbing smoke run (generated by `assays_any_isa.py smoke`; do not edit)

**Plumbing only.** Uniform random tapes and partners; no evolved 6502 soup was used. The assay outputs were checked for type and shape only: no score, rate or class count of a 6502 program is computed into this report or printed, because the 6502 test is not yet registered (`planning/PREREG_6502_DRAFT.md`).

Machine: `m6502_assay_L16` — MOS 6502 (NMOS) 0.3.0 (experimental; variant nmos; compat 0.3; hooks fetch, instructionStart), zilion 0.3.0-dev; ring 32; init {"set": {"p": 32}, "stack": {"firstPushAt": "lastByte"}}; budget {"unit": "steps", "value": "perLane"}; ablation none; WGSL SHA-256 `6be319e0b84e76fcc5c3d1e548d8c4d0e1441bc08c8f20307ef0dcf52665b156` (`machines/PROVENANCE_assays.md`).

Every call below ran with the 6502 machine selected (`executor.using`), through the same functions the frozen Z80 scripts call; frozen parameters unless noted.

Pair counts are not shown where they depend on what the programs do (the transfer and population assays run more encounters when copies are made); the table says only whether the 6502 machine ran and whether a shader did.
